nodes.label: AF Homes Platform Architecture (SPAs, Vercel Function, Supabase)
Delivered Phase History (Phases 1-5 and later families)
Staff Effective-Permission Authorization Model
nodes.rationale: One model evaluated in two places that must agree — private.has_permission() in Postgres for RLS and authorizeAfHomes() in handlers; the principal is re-resolved per request with no cache, so a permission change applies on the next call.

nodes.label: Customer Ownership Authorization (separate system)
nodes.rationale: There is deliberately no modules row for the customer portal, so a customer can never be granted a staff capability; a signed-in staff member who also owns a customer record gets access to that one customer only.

nodes.label: Sale as a Frozen Commercial Record
nodes.rationale: Snapshots (cash price, minimum down payment, yearly points, commission rate, expected commission) are why an edited card plan cannot rewrite history; never recompute a historical sale from card_plans.

nodes.label: Only VERIFIED Money Counts
nodes.rationale: recorded is not money yet; rejected and voided never were. Every total, balance and activation decision comes from the payment rows on the server.

nodes.label: Card Credentials Rotated, Never Recovered
nodes.rationale: Identifiers are SHA-256 hashes, so a code cannot be displayed on demand without weakening at-rest security; reissue mints fresh values and returns the plaintext exactly once.

nodes.label: Redemption Points Transaction Rules
nodes.rationale: Scanning spends nothing; the client sends no figures; the identifier authorizes nothing — all three rules are load-bearing.

nodes.label: Government ID Numbers Are Write-Only
nodes.rationale: Stored on customers, never returned; browser roles have no SELECT privilege on the columns at all, and the values must never appear in an audit_events payload.

nodes.label: Idempotent afhomes_ Migration Discipline
nodes.rationale: One idempotent migration per change; because the runner skips recorded versions, corrections ship as forward-only reconcile files. After each batch run rls_invariants.sql and pnpm test:db:local.

nodes.label: Version-Control Rule (no git state changes without command)
nodes.rationale: The agent must never stage, commit, push, branch, tag, stash, reset or take GitHub actions unless explicitly commanded in the session; reading history and diffs is always allowed.

nodes.label: Real-PostgreSQL Execution Lesson
nodes.rationale: A schema that compiles is not a schema that works, and a test that cannot fail is not a test — pnpm test:db:local and test:db:harness are the only things that caught the recorded defects.

nodes.label: Session Handoff Protocol (replace, not append)
nodes.rationale: The file holds the latest handoff only — replace, do not append, so it stays dense with decisions, open threads and verification state.

nodes.label: Standing User Preferences
nodes.rationale: Apply without asking: smallest complete change, UI rounds are UI-only, short user-facing copy, gates on tsc/eslint/vitest, never adjust assertions to force a pass, secrets never returned.

nodes.label: Typography: Cormorant Garamond + Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts)
Open Graph and Brand Metadata ('Amazing & Fun. Your Home Away From Home.')
AF Homes Business Rules — ID Generator and Numbering
AF-CUS-YYYY-NNNNNN Customer Number Format
nodes.rationale: Format approved 2026-10-14 for printing only; issuance trigger, sequence policy, merges and legacy backfill stay blocked (OD-12). The document is not authorization to change production behavior.

nodes.label: AAI/AAO Accreditation Number
nodes.rationale: Numbers are 11 characters and never renumbered, reused or reissued; an accreditation number is not proof of current validity.

nodes.label: Linked Sales Reference
nodes.rationale: A display/reconciliation expression, not a distinct transaction — the immutable sale number is never replaced.

nodes.label: OD-01 Annual vs Monthly Sequence Scope (BLOCKER)
nodes.rationale: Reference sheets say annual, but the actual Register formulas and FrozenMonthMaxG count same-year-and-month rows; management must approve the scope and nothing is silently chosen.

nodes.label: OD-02 Accreditation Counter Scope (RESOLVED)
nodes.rationale: One company-wide monthly sequence shared by the AAI and AAO prefixes; a kind change transfers the member to a fresh number of the new kind and retires the old number into accreditation history.

nodes.label: OD-12 Customer ID Issuance Decision
nodes.rationale: Printed format resolved; issuance trigger, year-scoped vs lifetime allocation, duplicate merges and legacy aliases remain open — no production issuance until separately approved.

nodes.label: Transactional Identifier Allocation Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Never use MAX(number)+1, random guesses or browser-side counters; allocate under a locked counter with unique constraints, be idempotent per subject, and fail closed when the counter is exhausted.

nodes.label: Zero-Rate Freeze Defect (BUG-001)
nodes.rationale: FreezeSaleRates must not freeze a zero rate when the salesperson/referrer has not yet been entered — otherwise an accidental 0% becomes permanent.

nodes.label: Company Workbook Import Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Four aligned entry sheets merged by explicit Excel row; VBA is never executed and formula-only rows never become customers.

nodes.label: Nationwide Postal Reference
nodes.rationale: Resolution must be unique or it is a review hold; raw PSGC Cloud zip_code values are never trusted, and a source postal candidate never becomes the authoritative value without a successful resolution.

nodes.label: Preserved commit_customer_import_legacy_row Dispatcher
nodes.rationale: The preceding legacy RPC body is preserved in private and called through a dispatcher that adds the identity guard while keeping authoritative identifier-conflict checks first; reapplication must not capture the dispatcher recursively.

nodes.label: Local-Only Acceptance Status
nodes.rationale: Independent implementation available for review — not a production acceptance PASS; managed-stack application and authenticated browser acceptance remain unverified.

nodes.label: Isolated Worktree Delivery Protocol
nodes.rationale: Work exclusively in the isolated worktree; never reset/stash/overwrite the dirty shared checkouts, and push only the authorized non-force branch after gates pass.

nodes.label: Postal Data Provenance Rules
nodes.rationale: Dated community reference, not an official government master list; never misrepresent provenance or promise zero inaccuracies.

nodes.label: Migration Renumbering and Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: The runner records version prefixes as primary keys, so duplicate versions are a real collision; never rename or rewrite an applied migration on assumption.

nodes.label: Company source is the implementation target; observed code is never policy
nodes.rationale: A clear, complete documented rule is the implementation target; the rule file is a map, not the territory - inspect the cited company source yourself.

nodes.label: Refuse rule-behavior changes without a citable rule
nodes.rationale: Changing code without a rule is how MISMATCH rows are born; stop and state which rule or approval is missing. Never change a documented rule to match the existing implementation - record the gap, do not resolve it.

nodes.label: Cite rule IDs in code comments and tests
nodes.rationale: One ID per behavior; no formula duplication in comments. Preserve exact formulas, thresholds, effective dates and exceptions; never round or simplify numbers.

nodes.label: BR-ACM-01 - Assumed credit rates 40% VIP / 20% IGP, Director-adjustable
BR-ACM-02 - Credit reaches BA, PA, PB, quota measure and below-target review
BR-ACM-03 - Credit never touches Override; seller keeps DSC/DRI
BR-ACM-04 - Attribution automatic via current upline chain; vacancy rolls upward
BR-AUTH - Director-Controlled Figures, Per-Person Rates, Logging
BR-AUTH-01 - Every pay-governing figure Director-only, range-checked, warned, logged
nodes.rationale: Control is the record, not the restriction (A6 Part 1): the Director can move any figure; the system guarantees capture, including abandoned-at-warning attempts.

nodes.label: BR-AUTH-02 - Per-person rates resolve from standard; deviation is logged Director act returning row to PENDING
BR-CODE-01 - Exact-decimal money text plus BigInt arithmetic, no floats
BR-CODE-02 - Only VERIFIED money counts; remaining/overpaid derived server-side
BR-CODE-03 - Membership activates only on full verified payment; idempotent; mints credentials
BR-CODE-04 - Single-level flexible commission: account-role-0 precedence, windows, manual qualify-to-paid
BR-CODE-05 - Seller resolution: selling roles, self default, downline-only assignment, super_admin bypass
BR-CODE-06 - Spot-cash 7-day window from first verified payment
BR-CODE-07 - VIP payment schemes frozen at sale; no chaining
BR-CODE-08 - Points engine: integer points, tier caps, debt-first earning, spendable, peso conversion, tier discounts
BR-CODE-09 - Staff redemption is one server-priced transaction with fixed lock order and idempotency
BR-CODE-10 - Credentials rotate, never recover; QR/fallback hashed identifiers; gov IDs write-only
BR-CODE-11 - Dual authorization: staff permissions vs customer ownership, never mixed
nodes.rationale: Two authorization systems that never meet: staff permission caps a role; customer access is ownership of one record - a staff member who owns a customer record gets customer access to that customer only.

nodes.label: BR-CODE-12 - Sellability guard plus input normalization (validation, not policy)
BR-CTL - Approval Locks, Corrections, Close Month, Director Actions, Audit Log
BR-CTL-01 - Supervisor approval stamps account+time and locks the whole row
nodes.rationale: A receipt counts toward nothing until approved; the stamp is automatic and the lock covers the whole row.

nodes.label: BR-CTL-02 - Locked-row correction needs Director unlock, clerk correction, re-approve
BR-CTL-03 - Close Month writes values, refuses repeats, warns on unapproved
nodes.rationale: Close Month is FINAL and irreversible; both aborting and overriding an unapproved-receipt warning are logged.

nodes.label: BR-CTL-04 - Eleven Director actions under one password per action, all logged
BR-CTL-05 - REFERRAL RIGHT-REVIEW: sale referred over 1yr after referrer accreditation raises Director decision
BR-CTL-06 - Six-column audit log, Excel/Sheets reconciled row-for-row
BR-CUT-01 - New terms apply in full to both companies; sub-threshold sales never count
nodes.rationale: The cutover TIGHTENS terms (15% VIP down payments counted before, not after) so it must be presented as a change in terms with the reason, not as a clarification.

nodes.label: BR-CUT-02 - Already-credited Closed Deals protected by contracts; nothing else carried over
BR-DUAL - Dual Engagements, Transfers, Chain Integrity, Back-Dated Dates
BR-DUAL-01 - Dual engagement is two accreditation rows with link column and three warnings
nodes.rationale: The system key is the ACCREDITATION NUMBER, not the person; a transfer mutates the existing row so the old post cannot keep producing KPI.

nodes.label: BR-DUAL-02 - BROKEN CHAIN warns, never blocks; sub-team moves change every upline column
nodes.rationale: Warns, never blocks, because managing a sub-team across two teams can be deliberate; the danger is production flowing silently to the wrong leader while every figure looks ordinary.

nodes.label: BR-DUAL-03 - Back-dated engagement dates accepted; 12mo+ reads CONTRACT ENDED
BR-ENG - Engagement Dates, Periods, Transitional Months
BR-ENG-01 - Engagements start on the 1st or 16th; other days flagged, not blocked
BR-ENG-02 - Contract start date, never accreditation date, drives QP/EP
nodes.rationale: A blank contract start date silently routes a new hire to the stricter Extended Period branch - silent underpayment with nothing flagged.

nodes.label: BR-ENG-03 - First-month BA is compliance-based; contract clause is not a TCP gate
BR-ENG-04 - BA releasable monthly/semi-monthly by days; PA/PB/Override calendar-month only
BR-ENG-05 - Transitional month splits QP and correction stretch; one assessment each
BR-GEN-01 - Vacant post earns nil, downline rolls up
BR-GEN-02 - Override exact to receipt date; ends at End Date
BR-GEN-03 - Vacant seat earns no override in vacancy period
BR-GEN-04 - Successor inherits genealogy only; pre-appointment transactions excluded
nodes.rationale: A successor inherits the tree, not the fruit: historical TCP is excluded; collecting old accounts earns discounted R23 assumed credit instead of full value.

nodes.label: BR-GEN-05 - Leader covers the whole genealogy beneath them
BR-GEN-06 - BA/PA day-pro-rated on appointment and departure; Override/PB not pro-rated
BR-GEN-07 - Successor window never limits the upline
BR-OPS - Go-Live Prerequisites and Operational Controls
BR-OPS-01 - Contract start dates for every person before first live payroll
BR-OPS-02 - Placeholder passwords changed; VBA locked; three distinct secrets
BR-OPS-03 - Install Rev E / Apps Script v2.1 only; delete older copies
BR-OPS-04 - First-live-month run: backups, hand-checks, pre-5th approvals
BR-OPS-05 - People and documents: guides issued, walkthroughs done, no self-approval
BR-PAR-01 - DSC/DRI/Override follow accreditation, not engagement, for accreditation life
nodes.rationale: Commission jurisdiction belongs to the accreditation and commission policy, NOT the service contract; BA/PA/PB are the engagement-side compensation and neither system conditions the other.

nodes.label: BR-PAR-02 - Collector credit and seller commission on one receipt are both correct
BR-PB - Performance Bonus, Equivalent TCP, Table A, Collection Quota
BR-PB-01 - Equivalent TCP carries no minimum collection rate (B19 = 0%)
nodes.rationale: A 10% floor would be STRICTER than the contract text - the dangerous direction; B19 stays Director-only so a floor can be imposed later with contracts amended together.

nodes.label: BR-PB-02 - Equivalent TCP formula: collection divided by 40%, capped at Team TCP, quota-gated
BR-PB-03 - Table A: thresholds, allowances, PB rates per position
nodes.rationale: The SVD-below-SSM PB rate (2% vs 3%) is deliberate and confirmed - recorded so it is not corrected later.

nodes.label: BR-PB-04 - 40% monthly collection quota gates PA and PB (aggregate, independent)
nodes.rationale: The 40% monthly quota is measured on the month in aggregate and is NOT the per-sale closed-deal threshold - the two must not be conflated.

nodes.label: BR-QLF - Closed-Deal Qualification, Thresholds, Freezing, Reversals, Payout Stages
BR-QLF-01 - Qualification is automatic on counted APPROVED collections
BR-QLF-02 - Thresholds: AFhomes VIP 25%, AFhomes IGP 10%, JA&D IGP 10%
nodes.rationale: Below the line a sale is a concession, still pending, not a closed deal; the thresholds are STRICTER than the contract text and were written into the DST contracts via the 21 Aug Addendum.

nodes.label: BR-QLF-03 - Qualification date freezes; threshold changes bind new qualifications only
nodes.rationale: Lowering the line judges every not-yet-qualified sale live and is the most careful parameter: warn before acceptance, log abandonment; no retroactive re-judgement.

nodes.label: BR-QLF-04 - Refund removes qualification outright; replacement qualifies from zero
nodes.rationale: Qualification is judged PER TRANSACTION: a refund is not a slide down a percentage; UPGRADED/DOWNGRADED receipts move to the new number, CANCELLED receipts stay in collection totals as-cash.

nodes.label: BR-QLF-05 - Closed-deal gate and stage-1 payout gate are independent
nodes.rationale: Counts vs pays: a sale can be a closed deal and have paid out no commission; the two thresholds must never be conflated.

nodes.label: BR-QLF-06 - Qualified TCP renamed Closed Deal TCP (presentational)
BR-RATE - DSC/DRI Rates, Freezing, Anniversaries, Early Performers
BR-RATE-01 - DSC/DRI rates freeze at sale-number issue
BR-RATE-02 - Zero rate never freezes (BUG-001 fix)
nodes.rationale: BUG-001: a zero rate froze permanently and silently because the formula-level verification could never catch it; a zero means the salesperson is not yet recorded, so the formula stays live.

nodes.label: BR-RATE-03 - Anniversary rate reviews; only new sales carry new rates
BR-RATE-04 - Early-performer single-cell unlock: one rate cell, one sale, then re-approve
BR-RATE-05 - Shipped default rates (DRI 5%/4%, DSC IGP 8%); VIP DSC default NOT LISTED
BR-RATE-06 - Invalid inputs generate NO sale number; duplicates prevented at freeze
BR-REV-02 - Two consecutive months below target from 3rd natural month; pair recorded
BR-REV-03 - Unrecorded review retains the engagement; pending count reported on open
nodes.rationale: The system never drops anyone by silence; it only keeps asking - a missed review is a management lapse and must not fall on the person concerned.

nodes.label: CF-01 - Which commercial model governs v2
nodes.rationale: Both models are internally coherent and share terminology (VIP, commission, genealogy, threshold) but different mechanics; no statement of relationship exists in the present files, so any cross-model conformance claim is blocked. Owner: company president.

nodes.label: CF-02 - Qualification gate: 25%/10% approved vs 100% verified
nodes.rationale: A VIP sale at 30% collected counts in the workbook but activates nothing in v2; whether v2 cards are the workbook VIP product is unresolved (owner: company president).

nodes.label: CF-03 - C2 version authority
nodes.rationale: Filename dates the memo 2026-08-20 but the in-ZIP mtime is 2026-10-11; cannot tell the signed version from a later edit or re-export.

nodes.label: CF-04 - Thresholds stricter-than-contract (resolved in-source, externally unverifiable)
nodes.rationale: Resolution depends on absent instruments (C3-C7), so the stricter-than-contract thresholds are recorded as DOCUMENTED FACT, not corroborated.

nodes.label: CF-05 - Master List identity
nodes.rationale: The prescribed reading order's step 1 is unresolvable: no file or sheet named Master List exists in the 18 present files; candidate artifacts were rejected with reasons.

nodes.label: CF-06 - UPGRADED counting: Reference R55 vs A24/R15
nodes.rationale: Resolved NOT silently by document hierarchy: newer and higher authority governs (C2 governs earlier memoranda; A24 postdates the v5.0 guideline text it corrects); R55's counts is read as completed-sale history only.

nodes.label: Generator payroll model (BA/PA/PB, DSC/DRI, QP/EP, Equivalent TCP, Close Month)
v2 membership-card model (verification-gated activation, points, single-level commission)
Proves means the cited test asserts the documented requirement, not adjacent behavior
X2 - Qualification + payout engine (Lane 4 cross-model build)
X4 - Settlement + Director console (Lane 4 cross-model build)
Never block unambiguous work on unrelated blocked work
nodes.rationale: Groups are independent lanes; within a lane dependencies order the work and no lane blocks another lane's unambiguous work.

A2 - AFhomes VIP/IGP Integrated Generator v10.2.0 workbook
A4 - AFhomes VIP/IGP Integrated Generator User Guide 2026-09-10a

B8 - AFhomes v10.2.0 Build Note and Module Hooks

nodes.rationale: Blocks all authority; owner: company president.

D-Q1 - Which commercial model governs v2
nodes.rationale: Smallest fact needed: one presidential sentence (alongside / superseded / out-of-scope) plus effective date; depends on all 32 NOT_IMPLEMENTED builds.

nodes.label: D-Q2 - Cutover scope for v2 data
D-Q3 - Qualification gate and product identity
Documentation Status Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Statuses describe evidence and implementation progress, not business-policy approval gates: a clear documented rule stays the implementation target even when code mismatches. Never invent a rule to fill a gap; never relabel a MISMATCH to make it disappear.

nodes.label: TEST_VERIFIED Evidence Rule
nodes.rationale: Never claim verification on file existence alone — always record command, date and result.

nodes.label: Q10 DB-Test Approval Gate
nodes.rationale: DB-backed specs need explicit approval (Q10) before their evidence can support conformance claims; unit specs run offline.

nodes.label: Normative Rule Record Fields
nodes.rationale: Every field is kept — write UNKNOWN or NOT VERIFIED instead of omitting one, so no rule record hides a missing detail.

nodes.label: Existing Transfer RPC Reused; AAI suffix preserved under AAO
Stable Request IDs with Transactional Retry/Conflict Handling
Sponsor-Picker Bug: generic head-of-SM query returned SSMs
Renewal Policy: management-chosen start, one calendar year, Feb 29 clamp, no overlap
IST/OST Guided Import and Export Handoff
Members Import/Export: preview then confirm, sequential Create IST/OST endpoint calls
Customer Company Workbook Template as the design/control reference
Generated Matching Row Keys Detect One-Tab Misalignment
Credentials Displayed Once; Consumed Preview Never Auto-Retried
nodes.rationale: A failed row stops the batch and retains completed results; the consumed preview is disabled from automatic retry because a lost response is ambiguous and repeating it could double-create members.

nodes.label: Preview Held in Memory - No Resumable Server Import-Job Ledger
Manual OST Sponsor Field Must Return Active Sales Managers
AAI to AAO Accreditation Conversion Preserving the Numeric Suffix
Annual OST Accreditation Renewal (Sellers Accreditation Renewal Form V1.3)
Genealogy Transfer Allowed Only After Accreditation Expiry
nodes.rationale: An active OST must not be able to change teams; only an expired accreditation may request a transfer, enforced on the server and in the database workflow so profile edits, direct API calls or RPCs cannot bypass it.

nodes.label: Frozen Applicant Information with Governed Update Path
Immutable Accreditation History (original date, expiry snapshots)
nodes.rationale: A submitted renewal retains its own historical applicant snapshot and previous expiry; later approvals update the current accreditation without rewriting any prior renewal record.

nodes.label: Renewal Approval Chain: SM endorsement, SSM/VD approval, no fabricated signatures
PSGC Cascading Address Dropdowns + Verified ZIP (never derived from PSGC numbers)
Atomic Creation: no partial or orphaned accounts, no fabricated hierarchy
nodes.rationale: OST creation must be atomic so a failed submission leaves no half-created account, and missing SSM/SM levels are never fabricated for directly-referred accounts.

nodes.label: Genealogy Structure VD to SSM to SM to OST
Temporary Password with Forced Change at First Sign-In (no invitation email)
Region Selector Removed from the Manual Creation Form (server still verifies hierarchy)
Auth Identity Cleanup Only for Newly Created Identities
nodes.rationale: Only an Auth identity created by the same request may be removed after a confirmed SQL rejection with no installed member; uncertain outcomes preserve the identity and require administrator review, so no automatic reuse or password reset can occur.

nodes.label: Team Move Preserves Role, AA Number and Term - Not a Conversion
nodes.rationale: A team move only swaps the genealogy edge; it does not renew accreditation, replace the AA number, create an identity or change roles, so it is a separate operation from IST-to-OST conversion.

nodes.label: Release Review: Applied Eight vs develop
OST_ROLE_WORKFLOW_REQUIRED Blocker Reproduced on Develop Baseline
Migration Lineage and Rollout Compatibility Unreconciled
Applied Migration Bodies Treated as Immutable; Corrections Delivered Forward
nodes.rationale: Versions already recorded live can never receive corrected bodies because the runner skips recorded versions, so every correction must ship in a new forward migration and the applied bytes are frozen evidence.

nodes.label: Explicit Commit Allowlist (no wildcards, no git add -A)
Nine 20261208 Migrations with SHA-256 Prefixes and Live Status
Deployed Code x SQL State Compatibility Matrix
nodes.rationale: Each row is proven rather than assumed so the ordering constraint is explicit: the new 12-argument caller must never run before migration 09, while the 11-argument wrapper keeps already-deployed code working, making a code-only rollback always available.

nodes.label: Six-Step Release Sequence with Three Separate Approvals
Wrapper Derives Request ID Deterministically so Old-Code Retries Replay
Scoped Approvals A (commit) / B (live apply) / B(c) backup / C (push+deploy)
Disposable Loopback PostgreSQL Battery (suite 2635/2635, gate 136, harness 13/13)
Encrypted Live Backup + Restore Rehearsal (12/12 checks, auth-then-app order)
Deploy Only After Migration 09; Code-Only Rollback Stays Available
nodes.rationale: The new application code calls the 12-argument transfer RPC which only exists after migration 09, while the transitional 11-argument wrapper keeps the deployed call shape working, so deploy must follow the migration and rollback stays safe at any point.

nodes.label: Excluded: Paused Customer/VIP Numbering Rollout
nodes.rationale: The merge excludes the numbering rollout and migration-dependent application hierarchy changes; their preparation stays in the original commits and a separate local worktree — no SQL, no renumbering, no history rewrite.

nodes.label: Confirmed Scoped Live Migration Applications Log
2026-10-16 Apply: Membership/Sale-Team Reconcile + Company Workbook RPC (77 to 79)
2026-10-17 Apply: Migration 09 Develop Transfer Integration (92 to 93, 28/28 checks)
2026-10-17 Apply: Migration 10 Direct OST Password (93 to 94)
2026-10-17 Apply: Migration 11 OST Team Transfer (94 to 95)
Unchanged History Differences: 11 repo migrations absent from live; no blind replay
nodes.rationale: A version absent from live history is not proof its body never ran - live SSOT bodies already match despite a missing version record - so history differences must never be fixed by stamping, replaying or applying unrelated migrations.

nodes.label: 14-Digit Version as Runner Primary Key (duplicate filenames silently skip)
nodes.rationale: apply-migrations.ts records the version as primary key, so when two files share a version the runner skips one silently; passing harness results did not prove this case, which is why an explicit reconciliation migration and focused suite exist.

nodes.label: Supabase Free Capacity and Implementation SSOT
Free-Plan Budget Table (5 GB egress x2, 500 MB DB, 50k MAU, 1 GB storage, 1 GB logs, 100 GB queries)
Query and Backend Rules (authorize first, narrow projection, bound pages, SQL aggregates)
nodes.rationale: Performance work must never cache stale staff permissions or expose raw documents; a faster read must return the same authorized truth, so narrowing is bounded by ownership, RLS, column grants and exact money rules.

nodes.label: Documents view=summary Omits OCR Review Payload
Public Sale-Team AA Verification (exact lookup, no-store, AA survives renewal)
Database Normalization Checkpoint APPLIED AND VERIFIED (2026-10-14)
Orphan commission_rules.target_id: archival plus generated FK repair
Company Direction: possible MongoDB Version 2, Supabase authoritative until decided
nodes.rationale: Supabase may be temporary or permanent pending a company architecture decision, so contracts, permissions, exact money, ownership and frozen history stay explicit; no dual writes or speculative abstraction layer are added now.

nodes.label: Index Audit and Discipline (card_sales is about 91 percent indexes)
Audit Payload Hygiene (IDs, statuses, reasons only)
JSONB Payload Control - no base64 blobs or full provider responses
Denormalized-Column Discipline (memberships.points_balance lesson)
nodes.rationale: A denormalized column nobody maintains is worse than none - memberships.points_balance was written once as 0 and never kept in step, misreporting balances - so every stored copy of a computed value needs a writer or owner.

nodes.label: Retention/Archival Policy Gate (dry run, approval, audit entry)
Bloat and Vacuum Management (fillfactor, autovacuum, VACUUM ANALYZE)
audit_events Monthly Partitioning plus Archived Partitions
Phase 1 Plan: Egress and Bandwidth Reduction
Projection Audit and Narrowing (explicit column lists, view=summary pattern)
Bounded List Pages with Stable Ordering and Pagination Metadata
Aggregates in Scoped SQL, Not JavaScript Downloads
Polling and Cache Hygiene (conservative intervals, 30 s freshness, no background polling)
60-Second Client Deadline and Caller Cancellation Propagation
Query Allowance = 100 x Same-Month Ingest (Free: 100 GB)
No Polling of Log Endpoints; Explorer Is Ad-Hoc Only
nodes.rationale: Every scheduled re-scan re-scans with zero caching benefit, making polling the single most expensive pattern and therefore forbidden for scripts, crons, CI and dashboards.

nodes.label: Business Questions Answered via audit_events/Reports, Not Logs
Degraded-State Chain: 10 queries/min + 1 h Retention, then Month-2 Cutoff
Log Ingestion Meter: 1 GB per cycle, org-wide, per byte
Reduce a Log Type's Volume - Never Disable Logging
nodes.rationale: A security incident or slow query missed because logging was off is worse than the bytes saved, so log settings are raised as thresholds rather than turned off.

nodes.label: Transaction Pooler (:6543) Enforcement for All DB Clients
Postgres log_statement / log_min_duration_statement Review (approval plus trend check)
log_statement=all Can Leak Plaintext Parameters
nodes.rationale: Full statement logging records query text including plaintext values such as passwords passed as parameters, so enabling it requires a sensitive-data check and log-access/retention confirmation first.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Plan: Monthly Active Users Control
MAU = Distinct Users That Sign In or Refresh a Token per Cycle
Invite-Only / Token-Gated Onboarding Preserved (no open signup)
nodes.rationale: Staff enter through staff_invitations and customers activate through single-use expiring onboarding tokens, so MAU hygiene must never trade away the invite-only model that protects onboarding integrity.

nodes.label: CI/QA/Load Tests Stay Off Managed Auth
Ghost-Session Hygiene (sign out kiosk devices, global sign-out)
Phase 4 Plan: File Storage Control plus Public URL Media
Bucket Limits Audit (afhomes-service-images has no explicit file_size_limit)
sha256 Dedupe plus Same-Grant Retry Reuse (never cross-customer)
Public URL Media Model (platform + embed_id, https-only validators)
Profile Buckets (public + private) with 0.5 MB Stored-Size Pipeline
Server Never Fetches User-Supplied URLs (SSRF guardrail)
nodes.rationale: Browsers load external media directly and the server validates format only, so a hostile URL can never make the server issue an outbound request; the renderer builds embeds from platform plus embed_id alone.

nodes.label: Private Identity and Receipt Files Never Get a URL Alternative
nodes.rationale: Identity documents and payment receipts stay in private buckets with hash verification and signed delivery; no public bucket or external host is ever an acceptable substitute for private files.

nodes.label: Reuse Create IST/Create OST APIs
nodes.rationale: Spreadsheet validation is convenience only; the creation APIs stay authoritative and no provisioning SQL is duplicated. Heads must exist first: VD, SSM, SM, then OST.

nodes.label: One-Time Credential Display
nodes.rationale: Credentials are displayed once after explicit confirmation and never placed in audit, local storage, workbook templates or normal exports.

nodes.label: Triple Citation and Guarded Paths
nodes.rationale: Every calculation carries its rule ID in SQL comment, TS docblock and spec name; guarded paths need a cited APPROVED rule plus human approval before they change.

nodes.label: Phase 0-6 Execution Plan
nodes.rationale: Entry to each phase requires the previous phase's acceptance; any failed acceptance returns to the blocking question, never forward by exception.

nodes.label: Q1 Workbook Payroll vs v2 Model Authority
nodes.rationale: President-only question: is the workbook payroll still operative alongside v2, superseded by it, or out of scope? It blocks all authority.

nodes.label: Business Rules Source Audit and Code Traceability
Business Rules.zip Inventory (18 of 30 files)
nodes.rationale: Twelve files (Pack C C3-C7 contracts, Pack D QA archive) are absent, so supersession and contract-gap claims rest on a single source.

nodes.label: Master List Identity Unresolved
nodes.rationale: No file or sheet carries the name; the prescribed reading order's first step cannot be satisfied, so complete coverage cannot be certified.

nodes.label: Workbook Payroll vs v2 Commercial Model Conflict
nodes.rationale: The v2 application implements membership cards, points and single-level commission, not the workbook payroll (BA/PA/PB, DSC/DRI, QP/EP, Equivalent TCP). A docs/business-rules tree built from the ZIP alone would describe a system the app does not run, so a presidential ruling blocks everything.

nodes.label: BR-QLF-01 Qualification Gate Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Documented 25% VIP / 10% IGP auto-qualification versus implemented 100%-verified activation (SALE_NOT_FULLY_PAID); same subject, materially different gate, needing a stakeholder ruling.

nodes.label: Code-Only Behaviors Requiring Business Validation
nodes.rationale: Points accrual/caps/debt, 7-day spot cash, VIP schemes, redemption, QR rotation, tier discounts and portal paths exist only in code — none may be written up as approved without a source or new ruling.

nodes.label: Documented Rules Missing from the Application
Not-Ready Verdict for Controlled Implementation
nodes.rationale: Not ready: the reading order's first step is unresolvable, 12 of 30 files are absent, the top ruling file has a version anomaly, no test was executed, and the payroll/application model question is unsettled. Writing the rule tree then would enshrine one side's numbers.

nodes.label: Positional Header Mapping
nodes.rationale: Header duplicates (ADDRESS x2, EMAIL ADDRESS x2, FULL NAME x2) are load-bearing; name-keyed aliasing would merge primary and supplementary data, so mapping is positional and applied only on an exact 45-column header row.

nodes.label: FULL NAME Split Blocked
nodes.rationale: Splitting FULL NAME would invent identity parse rules; rows without split names fail safely on required first/last names instead.

nodes.label: TIN Write-Only Handling
nodes.rationale: No browser grant, masked read, never audited — the same least-disclosure posture applied to government IDs.

nodes.label: Implemented: Single Template plus Company Fields
Unresolved: FULL NAME Split and Vocabularies
CF-02 Gate Mismatch
nodes.rationale: The phase reports label the documented-vs-implemented qualification-gate MISMATCH BR-QLF-02, while the traceability audit labels the 25%/10% gate MISMATCH BR-QLF-01 — a rule-identity discrepancy flagged for review.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Report — Investigation and First Slice
BR-RATE-01 Ordering Half
nodes.rationale: Chosen as first slice because ordering is independently clear, applies to v2 without touching the payroll-model question, is offline-testable, and the BUG-001 history proves ordering bugs in this area are silent and real.

nodes.label: W7 OST-Commission Dead Path
nodes.rationale: The commission resolver supports a seller_type='ost' branch but sale creation hardcodes 'staff', so OST-targeted rules are currently unreachable — a dead path or future hook that must not be silently activated.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Report — Coverage and Next Slice
Per-Domain Correction Flow
nodes.rationale: Correction is per-domain by evidence: BR-QLF-04 strip-on-refund has no card-payment target in v2, so applying it would invent card refunds; a generic void endpoint would invent cross-domain semantics.

nodes.label: Phase 5 Report — Clear Rules and Source Gaps
BR-RATE-06 Invalid Inputs Generate No Number
nodes.rationale: Numbering integrity is audit-critical — every gap is an unexplainable hole in the sequence auditors reconcile, so validation must run before the number is consumed.

nodes.label: Phase 6 Report — Verification and Second Slice
BR-RATE-06 Extended to Customer Numbers
nodes.rationale: Same documented rule, second sequential series with the identical defect class: a duplicate was detected only at insert, after the number was consumed, so deterministic pre-checks were added before next_customer_number.

nodes.label: CONFORMANCE-EVIDENCE.md
nodes.rationale: Full-suite green certifies no regressions, never conformance; only BR-RATE-06 asserts its documented requirement directly.

nodes.label: SPA to Single Function to Supabase Request Flow
F2 Verified-Only Money
nodes.rationale: recorded is not money; every total, balance and activation decision derives from verified payment rows.

nodes.label: G Staff Authorization
nodes.rationale: Effective permission resolved per request with no cache; frontend navigation is UX-only and every action is re-checked server-side.

nodes.label: G Customer Ownership Authorization
nodes.rationale: Ownership only — no module keys, resolution is not authorization, and identifier lookup carries no PII in its response.

nodes.label: SQL-Authoritative vs TS-Preview Drift Risk
nodes.rationale: commerce.ts is a preview/validation mirror while the SQL RPC is authoritative, so preview can say ok while the database refuses.
